comment: City News print an article indicating that Firewolf might be breaking up. After a long period of internal conflict, they now have decided go separate ways, it says.
name: Press
Headline: Firewolf Break Up?
Caption: Firewolf Break Up Beef Killed Music
question: What to do?

comment: <¤CBand.name> causes a minor political crisis when the press reports that the Trade Minister's wife spent the night in <¤CRealMusician.name>'s hotel room.\n\tIt will likely result in divorce and the minister leaving office. Oh well!
The band finds <¤CRealmusician.name> unconscious following a drug overdose.\n\tYou manage to wake him up, but he definitely needs medical attention in order to survive.

Eddie has changed his lifestyle completely. Now he demands that all food being served to him be biodynamically produced, contain no meat and be rinsed in spring water before cooking.\n\tHis new lifestyle is costly and he demands you raise his pay.
Sonny has met a girl. Her name is Anette and they are very fond of each other. He says she gives him inspiration and calls her his muse.

Sonny van Lord's girlfriend Anette thinks that Firewolf's music should be harder. She says that nobody likes soft music anymore.\n\tSonny says she's right, but the rest of the band don't seem to agree.

Sonny van Lord's girlfriend Anette thinks that Firewolf should have a more spectacular stage show.\n\tSome fire, maybe a few dancers and guest artist should do the trick.\n\tSonny thinks that Anette's idea is great, but the rest of the band don't seem to agree.

Sonny van Lord's girlfriend Anette is disappointed with the media attention lately.\n\tShe thinks that the band members can't handle reporters and that Sonny doesn't get enough attention.\n\tShe suggests that Sonny becomes Firewolf's spokesman in future interviews.

<¤CRealMusician.name> met Lola Hertz at a party recently. <¤CRealMusician.firstname> flirted with her in hopes that she would play their songs more often.\n\tIn a dark corner of the party, they let one thing lead to another. Not before long, they were licking each other's ears!\n\tWhen Lola asked <¤CRealMusician.firstname> if he wanted to come back to her place to see some of her etchings, <¤CRealMusician.firstname> got cold feet, saying it was because Lola has such ugly eyebrows!

A woman in the audience was hit in the eye by a Mortensen drumstick that slipped from Manny's hand during your recent concert.\n\tApparently, Mortensen drumsticks have extremely low surface friction and therefore easily slip.\n\tThe doctor says she will be OK, but the lady threatens to sue the band for pain and suffering.
Firewolf are furious that you would try to change their band name. They immediately change it back and warn you about trying anything like that again.
<¤CrealMusician.name> has recovered from his overdose and is back to business as usual.
<¤CrealMusician.name> is urgently ill. His doctor sends him to detox because he had a whole pharmacy in his system.\n\t<¤CrealMusician.name> will be out for at least a month.

The court frees <¤CrealMusician.name> from all charges of abuse, possession and trafficking of drugs.\n\tHis lawyer said Andy's conscience "is as white as snow." That decided things as far as the court was concerned.\n\tAlso, you spot Sergey's car outside the judge's office.

The court sentences Andy Rokks to four years incarceration for drug-related activity.\n\tThe motivation behind the sentencing was the organized distribution of drugs at Springfield Elementary School (where both school yard attendants and the students' council where part of the business).\n\tAndy won't be able to play with Firewolf for a few years.

Following Andy Rokks' drug offence, the PTA demand that record shops stop selling all Firewolf records.\n\t"Will Firewolf take responsibility if our children become drug addicts? Of course not, they are only interested in money!" says PTA chairman Ed Stone on Radio FM News.

City News run a full page on Andy Rokks drug dealing enterprise.\n\tThe article states that the police found elementary school student directories in Andy's apartment, and that the words "Lick Here" are printed on the inside of Firewolf's record sleeves.\n\tAndy Rokks is, according to City News' sources, cousin of the infamous drug baron Il Conte who has used him to recruit new customers.

Eddie St. Johns has slept with Sonny van Lord's girlfriend. They took their chance when Sonny went to the guitar shop to buy strings.\n\tSonny van Lord says he's going to tear Eddie's guts out  literally!\n\tIt might take some time before they can work together again.

The Parent Teacher Association recommends that record buyers boycott <¤Cband.name> because band musician, <¤CRealmusician.name>, asked audience members during a live show if there were any girls in the crowd who wanted to go backstage and "play his flute."\n\tThe PTA wants everybody who cares for the future of their daughters to avoid the band.

The Promoter claims the demands in your sixty-page rider are preposterous.\n\tIt would cost him $10.000 to heat the venue ahead of time, and you would have to pay for that yourself.\n\tThe alphabet crackers he can arrange, though.

Manny Swift pinched one of Sonny van Lord's guitars. Sonny got it back when he threatened to piss in Manny's bass drum, but now the guitar sounds strange.\n\tSonny is grumpy and doesn't want to rehearse.

Manny Swift only wants to stay in and read all the time, while the rest of Firewolf are busy pouring liquor over each other in night clubs. The band worries about Manny.\n\tManny himself explains that he finds reading more rewarding than drinking.
Sonny van Lord has been infected with a sexually transmitted disease.\n\tIt will go away with a bit of penicillin, but Sonny is so ashamed he doesn't want to be seen in public for a while.

Sonny van Lord threatens to leave Firewolf. He has had it with the criticism against Anette and says that love is more important than music.\n\tSonny says he can't understand how Firewolf can take Anette's well-meaning advice as criticism. He thinks the rest of the band are ungrateful idiots.
Sonny van Lord wants to apologise to Firewolf. He has broken up with Anette and regrets that he fought with the band. He apologises for the harsh words.

<¤CBand.name>'s new video receives massive media attention.\n\tUnfortunately, it's not a music video, but a film of the band having a liquor and sex orgy with a dozen fans in a hotel room.\n\tNobody knows who shot it, but now it's everywhere.

The police have apprehended Sonny van Lord at the Mirror Ball men's room where he was having sexual intercourse with another man.\n\tA field day for the press, the pictures of the men being brought out of the nightclub in handcuffs are all over.\n\tSonny is later released without consequences.
Sonny van Lord's girlfriend Anette thinks that Manny Swift is not a good enough drummer to be playing with Firewolf.\n\tShe thinks that you should find a better drummer.

The show is delayed because <¤CRealMusician.name> is "sick to his stomach" and vomits in the dressing room for two hours.\n\tThe crowd waits patiently, but when Firewolf finally go on stage, the atmosphere is tense.

<¤CrealMusician.name>'s long hair catches in the strings of his guitar.\n\tThe sound engineer runs up with a pair of scissors and cuts loose <¤Crealmusician.firstname>, who finishes the gig with hurt pride.

Sonny van Lord can't find his guitar tuner. It's missing and Sonny doesn't have time to tune his guitars properly before the gig.\n\tAfterwards, the band discovers that Manny hid the tuner, and the band blames him for the disastrous show.
The record label gives you a letter from some young fans. They are a bunch of ten year olds who send pictures of themselves dressed as <¤CBand.name>.\n\tThe band feel very honoured.
Some fans call to say that they have made a fansite for <¤CBand.Name>. Now they want an interview with the band.
The fans that made the fansite for <¤Cband.Name> ask if they can get some free tickets to your next show. It would cost <formatCurrency(tmp)>.

The fans that made the fansite for <¤Cband.Name> ask if they can have a few free copies of your new record.\n\tThey want to post a review of the record, and give away copies as prizes for a contest they are holding on their site.

The fans that did a fansite for <¤Cband.Name> ask if they can get some backstage passes for your next show. They feel they've become so close to the band now, that they would like to meet them at the backstage party.
The fans that made a fansite for <¤Cband.Name> ask if they can travel with <Cband.Name> on the tour. \n  They feel they've really connected with the band and want to tag along on tour.

Notorious instrument maker Mortensen offers <¤Cband.name> $45000 if they use Mortensen gear on all their official appearances.\n\tMortensen are known for subpar quality, but it might be worth the extra dough.

<¤CRealMusician.name> complains that drunken strangers are hanging out in their tour bus all the time.\n\tThe band can't sleep, read, play cards or solve crossword puzzles because of the noise.\n\t<¤CBand.name> are too old to party twenty-four-seven, but this crowd doesn't seem to care.
<¤CrealMusician.name> says he's had it with all the people hanging out in their dressing room at every gig. \n\tHe wants to know where they all come from and why they always drink all the beer.

<¤CRealMusician.name> wants to add some extra magic to the show.\n\tHalfway into the gig {x;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<¤CRealMusician.gender>]} produces a frog from a box and bites it's head off, much to the crowd's delight.\n\tSoon thereafter {x;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<¤CRealMusician.gender>]} begins to vomit and has to leave the stage for an ambulance ride to the emergency room where {x;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<¤CRealMusician.gender>, #Genitive:1]} stomach is pumped out.

Sonny van Lord feels you have treated his girlfriend Anette unjustly. You say you like her ideas, but you don't act on it.\n\tHe gets the impression you don't really respect her, which means you don't respect him and his skills as a guitarist.
Andy Rokks has had a psychosis.\n\tAfter emergency electric shock treatment at the hospital, he decides to move back in with his mum and live the safe life with milk and cookies everyday.

Halfway through the show, Sonny van Lord changes guitars. When he strikes the first chord on the new guitar, a flash shoots out from the amp.\n\tSonny falls down unconscious and the guitar is on fire. The show ends early, and the promoter only pays half.
Andy Rokks returns from detoxification. He looks a little better, but you should look after him closely.

During practice, Firewolf suddenly stops playing to watch Sonny van Lord's hair stand on end and see electric sparks shoot from his fingers.\n\tThe band laughs, but when Sonny's eyebrows smoke you realise he's in real trouble.\n\tYou push him away from the Mortensen amplifier that is sending electric shocks through his body.
You agreed to let Firewolf attempt to set a new volume record, but you still haven't booked a show.\n\tThe band are becoming frustrated, because they're eager to play loud.

You still haven't booked a concert for the volume record attempt. Firewolf are so disappointed that they fire you as their manager.\n\tNow they'll find somebody who believes in breaking the sound barrier with them.

The publicity for the high volume record attempt works well. City News runs a big story on the upcoming attempt at the volume record.\n\tThey also give a history of high volume records and host an interview with sound scientist Ian Agrosenius, who explains the scientific challenge in creating very loud sounds.
The band says the next gig is too far off. Someone else could break the record before that  they have even heard a rumor that Fatal Death are trying.\n\tYou should hurry up and book a gig.

Firewolf play in g-suits to an overly enthusiastic crowd wearing state of the art ear plugs.\n\tAn official measures a record-shattering 165 dB during Eddie's one minute sustained high note. That's way over the previously set record. The entire concert was louder than the old record!\n\tThe city spends weeks cleaning up the broken glass from the surrounding buildings.

Bitter and disappointed, Firewolf fire you as their manager.\n\tThey put their last savings on a grand sortie from the Rock 'n' Roll circus, but now it's all gone.\n\tThanks to you they'll have to spend the rest of their lives playing third class strip bars.

Try again and spend your cash more wisely this time.\n\tMake sure your concerts are successful by keeping your band happy before the gigs.\n\tCarefully market your record and work the media for free press.

Bitter and disappointed, Firewolf fire you as their manager.
	They put their last savings on a grand sortie from the Rock 'n' Roll circus, but now it's all gone.
	Thanks to you they'll have to spend the rest of their lives playing third class strip bars.
	Try again and do better.
Try again and do better. Make sure you have a successful album out before you embark on a world tour. Do lots of PR and marketing to promote sales.

<¤Crealmusician.name> has left the band and there's just no way the rest of them are going to continue without him.\n\tThey might fight at times, but Firewolf just wouldn't be Firewolf without the original members.
Rule 1A: Keep the band happy. Use any means necessary  gifts, booze, holidays, whatever.

The last gig was a total failure and Firewolf want to make sure that does not happen again.\n\tFifteen years ago, Firewolf were on the front pages of papers all over the world after a record smashing 130 dB concert at Colosseum. Now, with the help of advanced technology, they feel it's time to set new standards for concert volume.\n\tMortensen special equipment and protective gear for another record attempt would set you back $10.000.

Firewolf are really happy with their last gig, in fact they're so happy they want to do something extra for their next show.\n\tFifteen years ago, Firewolf were on the front pages of papers all over the world after a record shattering 130 dB concert at Colosseum. Now, with the help of advanced technology, they feel it's time to set new standards for concert volume.\n\tSpecial equipment and protective gear for the new attempt would set you back $10.000.

You meet to prepare for the concert, but Andy doesn't show. Time passes and you don't hear anything from him.\n\tAfter waiting, you have to cancel the show. Still nobody seems to know where Andy is at.
The next day, Andy is back. He says he has no idea what happened.\n\tHe doesn't remember anything and doesn't seem to care that the show was cancelled.

Andy Rokks doesn't dare leave his hotel room, because Jolly Roger of The Pirates has said that he's going to kick Andy's ass.\n\tAndy tells the horror tale of how The Pirates manhandled singer/song-writer Eric Flanders at last years Monsters of Mud.\n\tAndy is insecure whether he dares play or not.

The Pirates are up front yelling profanity during the first half of the gig.\n\tThen Jolly Roger slips in the mud and hits his head on the crowd barrier. They leave.\n\tAndy escapes without a scratch.

When you arrive to Monsters of Mud you have to wait in line for three hours to get the stage passes. Nobody knows where you are supposed to stay.\n\tThe band leaves you with all the gear to find accommodating groupie-campers.

When <¤Cband.name> is going on stage there's no electricity. The gig is delayed 45 minutes.\n\tTo keep the night's schedule, you shorten your set and end up being on stage for twelve minutes.\n\tThe crowd boos and the band sulks.

The threats from Jolly Roger made quite an impact on poor Andy. He just sits in the dressing room staring blindly into the mirror.\n\tAndy trembles like a leaf, spilling drinks and breaking things.\n\tThere's is no way Andy's gonna play tonight.
Rock festival Monsters of Mud wants to book you for a gig at this year's event.\n\tThey offer $5000 and you'll be gone for a week.

You take a closer look at the line up for Monsters of Mud and realise <¤Cband.name> are not playing the second biggest stage like you had been promised.\n\tInstead, they're set to play at a remote tent stage early in the afternoon, between two circus acts.

Just before the end of the show, something strange happens. Eddie St. Johns pushes Manny Swift's drums over and hits him in the head with a cymbal.\n\tThen the whole band jump in and take turns beating the crap out of Manny with instruments, microphone stands and amplifiers.\n\tAfterwards nobody wants to talk about it, but Manny has to stay in the hospital for a few days.
Firewolf have started a contest amongst each other about who can take most groupie scalps.\n\tAside the glory and the odd crab, the winner gets nothing in particular.

<¤CrealMusician.name> has started a sort of bonus system to make the roadies get him groupies.\n\tBefore every gig he gives out backstage passes with the roadies' names on. The owner of the backstage pass on the floor of <¤CrealMusician.firstname>'s room the next morning gets $100 and a crate of beer.\n\tEverybody wins, says <¤CrealMusician.firstname>.

Firewolf can't do the gig because they don't have any instruments!
	At first they say the gear was stolen, but after a while Andy Rokks admits he sold it all to buy drugs. Of course, the rest of the band are furious.
	Andy doesn't want to talk about it because he's been feeling really tired lately.
	Andy shall have to buy the gear back, but now the concert is in jeopardy.
Eddie St. Johns says he needs a custom made case for the champagne bottle he opens after every show. It might break without it.\n\tThe custom made case will set you back $2000.

Sonny van Lord's girlfriend Anette wonders why Firewolf's record sales are so bad.\n\tShe thinks that you should buy some more adverts and arrange a gig in the Record Store.\n\tAnette thinks that Firewolf are much better than most bands on the Top 10, and wants to know why aren't they listed.
Sonny van Lord's girlfriend Anette thinks that Firewolf are ready for a world tour. She wonders if you are really the right manager for them if you can't arrange a world tour.

Eddie St. Johns has had it with Anette's constant nagging, criticism and opinions. He can't stand her, put simply.\n\tNow Eddie wants you to tell Sonny that he must choose between Anette and Firewolf.

<¤CRealMusician.name> has a few specific requests for the next gig.\n\tThe dressing room is to have a temperature of exactly 21ºC at least an hour before Firewolf arrive, otherwise he can't warm up his vocal cords properly.\n\t<¤CRealMusician.firstname> also wants a bowl of alphabet crackers in his dressing room. But only the letter A.

Andy Rokks has been arrested. In his apartment was found controlled substances worth thousands.\n\tAlso, there was a metal hatch in his front door. Looks like Andy had another job on the side.\n\tAnyway, now he's gonna have to go to court, but he is out on bail until the trial.
Spotlight Tours call to offer their services as a tour promoter for your artists. It is Firewolf's good sales lately that has sparked their interest.
Douglas of City News calls to find out why the band hasn't split up yet. You told him the rumors where true.
